The dark arts of the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Caged Dog Village<CLT=cltNORMAL> 
were sealed away for being too effective.

<CLT=cltSTRONG>The Caged Child<CLT=cltNORMAL> was one such art. It seems 
feudal lords feared the words of the dead.
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Kiyo for a while?

"Dead men tell no tales"...
Kehehe...what a foolish saying.

There are countless ways to speak 
with the dead...

<CLT=cltMIND>I listened to Kiyo talk endlessly
about seances...
<CLT=cltMIND>Kiyo and I grew a little closer today.
